description:
Implement AVX2 batch-encoding kernels for binary BCH through the existing carry-less-multiply primitives and function-pointer dispatch seam in gf2-kernels-simd, with a dispatch predicate covering the complete required ISA feature set and the scalar fallback exercised in tests.

## Background

The kernel crate already exposes PCLMULQDQ primitives, AVX2 detection, and safe function-pointer dispatch with scalar selection; the design compiles on the Rust 1.95 MSRV. Runtime safety requires detecting the full feature set the kernels use — carry-less multiply support in addition to AVX2 — as one combined predicate. Unsafe code stays isolated in the kernel crate.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: AVX2 batch encoding produces bit-identical results to the scalar reference on the predeclared corpus rows, including the packed word-boundary lengths 0, 1, 63, 64, and 65 with little-endian indexing and zero tail padding.
- [hard] REQ-02: The dispatch predicate detects the complete ISA feature set the kernels require before selecting them, and the scalar fallback path is exercised by tests independent of host capability.
- [hard] REQ-03: Kernel-crate unsafe carries safety contracts naming the detected features.
title: AVX2 batch-encoding kernels with complete feature detection and tested scalar fallback
